title: Memory capsule preview, Out of date display group and in-chat traces
canonical_summary: The capsule preview is labelled "See what your next message will include" and counts memory notes only against assistant.memory.capsule_budget_tokens (rules never count against it); "Out of date" is a read-time display group of stale Verified gists and never a fourth verification_state; in chat memory is a "Noted" mark that relaxes after 3 s and one Verified line per milestone, with no noise when a note goes stale.
gui_classification_reason: Preview label, list grouping and in-chat marks are user-visible memory presentation.
exact_tokens: See what your next message will include
negative_constraints: Do not add a fourth verification_state.
Do not count taught rules against the memory capsule budget.
Do not render memory as a card or pop-up in chat.

title: Gist Edit as a versioned claim edit, and the half-life Settings link
canonical_summary: Edit is a versioned claim edit through cmd.chat.memory.edit that resets the gist to Unverified; the per-kind half-life editor links to memory.retention.half-life-by-kind through cmd.settings.open with no new command; cmd.chat.memory.edit has no GUI producer in the 2026-09-27 wave (CDRY-012).
gui_classification_reason: Edit and the half-life link are Gist Review actions.
negative_constraints: Do not let an edited claim keep Verified.
Do not mint a half-life memory command.

title: Plan card schedule line tokens and the two Plan-bound Crew modes
canonical_summary: The schedule line's states lead with their PFAIL-002 tokens beside the Build control, which stays Building…; Build With Crew mode dispatches cmd.chat.plan.build_with_crew (atomic, refuses stale_plan_version); scheduled mode starts nothing, freezes its configuration with cmd.chat.plan.schedule_build and disables what needs the user at dispatch.
gui_classification_reason: Plan card and Crew sheet behaviour.
exact_tokens: Scheduled builds can't use this: they run while you're away.
negative_constraints: Do not relabel the Build control from the schedule line.
Do not decompose Build With Crew into a collaboration start plus a build.

title: Pre-start run estimate contract
canonical_summary: estimate(definition) → {duration_s, cost_microdollars, replies?, basis {pricing_snapshot_id, latency_sample_ref}, source_class pricing_estimated}, pure and provider-free, never a UsageRecord, always labelled an estimate; no basis means no figure and never $0.00.
gui_classification_reason: The estimate line before Start is user-visible.
negative_constraints: Do not persist an estimate as usage.
Do not show a number without a basis.

title: Live run cost from the run group
canonical_summary: Live and final run cost is the sum of UsageRecords attributed to the run's usage_group_ref, per participant with source_class; unknown stays unknown; Back Seat Driver usage is never folded in; the compared limit is owned by the run's limit contract (the effective-limit choice waits on p16 E-33).
gui_classification_reason: Live cost on cards, dock and run view.
negative_constraints: Do not fold Back Seat Driver usage into a run.
